runtimeAdaptations: Clone source scene and materials; normalize offset origin and units to 5.715m length without rewriting source GLB.

Hide two source windshield/glazing mesh groups only in cockpit view; restore both in exterior chase view.
Mount the existing interactive PhysicalRadio on the native center dashboard and add a 24-bar instanced spectrum using the shared live analyser. No additional audio owner.
Add vehicle-specific cockpit, radio closeup and chase camera profile plus bounded cabin/headlight illumination.
visualValidation: Actual desktop 1280x720 and portrait 390x844 screenshots reviewed in combined Cruise. Original convertible cabin and complete chase car retained; corrected dashboard adapter and portrait camera keep the LCD, knobs, presets and live spectrum visible. Native gauges remain static source textures. Measured driving performance is reported separately.
